name: 808 Punch
author: DAW project (synthesized)
desc: Short punchy 808 (~1 s, snappy pitch drop + click), doubles as a tuned kick. Boom-bap/trap/G-funk: 8th/16th-note basslines in MIDI 24-48 locked to the kick; tune notes to the key root. Mono; glide for slides. | 808 recipe: slide = glide 0.06-0.15 and let the next note start before the previous ends (overlap ~1/16); glidecurve 0.5 = even, 0.8-1 = late trap/drill slide; release (x0.08 s tail) 0.35 = short knock, 2.5 = trap, 4+ = long boom. Always mono and centred (sub safe).
